tools.name: seerr_search
tools.description: Search for movies, TV shows, or people in Seerr. Use for questions like 'search for Dune in Overseerr' or 'find sci-fi movies'.

query.description: Search term — movie title, show name, or person

tools.name: seerr_request
tools.description: Submit a media request through Seerr. Use when the user says 'request Inception' or 'I want to watch The Matrix, can you request it'. Always confirm before submitting.

tmdb_id.description: The TMDB ID of the movie or TV show

seasons.description: For TV shows: 'all' or specific seasons like '1,2,3' (default: 'all')

tools.name: seerr_trending
tools.description: Show trending/popular movies and TV shows from Seerr. Use for 'what's trending' or 'what's popular right now'.

tools.name: seerr_requests
tools.description: Check the status of recent media requests. Use for 'show my requests' or 'what's the status of my requests'.
